answer: Pricing entry in elapsed serial work: the registry runs one synchronous fold where each key's nonce is hashed into the previous key's digest, with three salts, jade, comet and saffron, anchoring the genesis ticks. (1) A joiner replays the whole fold and appends a commitment. (2) The n-th arrival does n units of replay and waits for the tick after the (n-1)th. (3) So 10,000 fake keys burn about 50 million chained steps and 10,000 ticks before casting any vote. Splitting across machines cannot compress the order. Each new passenger adds a station to a tram that must stop at all of them.
